source.product: A high-resolution dataset of global economic activity: GDP and GDP per capita, 1990–2024
source.citation: Kummu, M., Kosonen, M. & Masoumzadeh Sayyar, S. 2025. Downscaled gridded global dataset for gross domestic product (GDP) per capita PPP over 1990–2022. Scientific Data 12:178. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04487-x

operation: Copy verified source band 30 (2019) to a single-band GeoTIFF; no resampling, reprojection, interpolation, unit conversion, or value adjustment.

output.missing_values: Source mask and NaN NODATA metadata preserved

validation: Readback verification compared CRS, transform, dimensions, mask, and all pixel values with the selected source band.
license: CC BY 4.0; cite the source paper and dataset DOI.
limitations: Values are downscaled from administrative level-2 statistics and have spatial allocation uncertainty; pixels are not independent measurements.
This product has not been matched to any aerosol pH model or other scientific input.
